uctalent.summary: Referral-based tech hiring platform: the uctalent.io job board and the business.uctalent.io Smart ATS. I ship features end to end across NestJS, FastAPI, Next.js and the React ATS.

bullets.production: Built SaaS subscription billing: mid-period upgrades with unused-period credit, saved-card auto-renewal, grace period, cancel / turn off renewal, next-period plan changes and recruiter seat quotas.
bullets.performance: Built interview scheduling on Google Calendar + Gmail: a week view of the recruiter's busy times, invitation emails, and a public page where candidates accept or request a new time.
bullets.reliability: Built AI services in FastAPI: Gemini CV extraction and evaluation, CV/job embeddings, similar-job search, and re-ranked RAG job recommendations for talent profiles.
bullets.endToEnd: Delivered the referral reward program: warranty periods with locked terms, email-link guarantee confirmation, payout milestones, admin invoicing and company referral bonuses.
bullets.agile: Shipped job lifecycle and compliance: ATS status split from job-board publishing with admin review, edit / re-post with revision review, GA4 consent tracking and data deletion requests.

bullets.ojt: Delivered an OJT project for school grading and learning management used in the internship evaluation.
bullets.fullstack: Built full-stack features with a Spring Boot (Java) API and a Vite + React frontend (Tailwind).
bullets.delivery: Worked in a 3-month internship cadence — requirements, implementation, and demo handoff.

guscent.title: Guscent
guscent.outcome: Headless CMS storefront — SEO-ready production launch.
guscent.summary: A design-led perfume storefront that turns mood-based storytelling and a scent quiz into a clear product-discovery and commerce journey.

bullets.highlight1: Built a smooth e-commerce storefront with mood-based storytelling using Next.js and React.
bullets.highlight2: Integrated headless CMS and REST APIs for flexible content and stable data flows.
bullets.highlight3: Shipped responsive UI and SEO-ready pages to production with a team of three.

highlights.shipped: Next.js App Router storefront: scent quiz, dynamic catalog/cart, checkout hooks, and CMS-driven editorial/product sections with reusable layout primitives.
highlights.decisions: Server Components + route-level data fetching; Zod-validated REST integration; accessible quiz state machine; resilient loading, empty, and error boundaries for headless CMS payloads.
highlights.impact: Production launch with responsive UI kit, optimized media, and a component architecture the team can extend without redesigning pages.

uctalent.title: uctalent.io & business.uctalent.io
uctalent.outcome: Production SaaS ATS — billing, interview scheduling, referrals and AI matching.
uctalent.summary: Referral-based tech hiring platform: uctalent.io is the job board for talents and referrers; business.uctalent.io is the Smart ATS where companies post jobs, run candidate pipelines, schedule interviews and pay for plans.

bullets.highlight1: Subscription billing: upgrades with unused-period credit, saved-card renewal, grace period, cancel, next-period plan change and seat quotas.
bullets.highlight2: Interview scheduling and candidate emails through the recruiter's connected Google Calendar and Gmail, with a public accept / reschedule page.
bullets.highlight3: AI pipeline: Gemini CV extraction and evaluation, embeddings, similar-job search and re-ranked RAG job recommendations.
bullets.highlight4: Referral warranty and payouts, job edit / re-post with revision review, and ATS status vs job-board publishing with admin review.

highlights.shipped: Billing (upgrade, renewal, grace, cancel, plan change, seat quota, quota history, VAT profile); interview scheduling with Google Calendar; Gmail-sent candidate and rejection emails; hiring team sharing and member invites; company talent pool; referral warranty, payouts and admin invoices; GA4/GTM consent banner; data deletion form and trust pages.
highlights.decisions: Split the ATS lifecycle (jobs.ats_status) from job-board visibility with a data migration; snapshot screening questions per application so edited jobs flag outdated AI scores; lock referral terms at referral time; token-based public pages for candidates and clients; DDD hexagonal NestJS modules; a standard 5xx error contract with request IDs.
highlights.impact: Recruiters go from posting a job to scheduling interviews in one workspace, paid plans renew and upgrade without manual ops, and referrers see reward terms that cannot change after they refer.

unchainlabs.title: Unchain Labs
unchainlabs.outcome: Marketing + Strapi — editors ship without frontend redeploys.
unchainlabs.summary: A production marketing site and headless CMS that lets the team publish structured business content without frontend rework.

bullets.highlight1: Delivered a Next.js marketing site with Strapi headless CMS and TypeScript end to end.
bullets.highlight2: Modeled dynamic zones, editor RBAC, and PostgreSQL-backed content with safe migrations.
bullets.highlight3: Launched SEO-ready production site so editors publish without frontend redeploys.

highlights.shipped: Next.js marketing site, Strapi content types, dynamic zone sections, media library workflows, validated contact API, and editor-friendly preview flows.
highlights.decisions: SSR/SSG hybrid with semantic HTML; Strapi RBAC for editor roles; PostgreSQL-backed CMS with migration-safe content models; sitemap, robots, Open Graph, and per-environment config.
highlights.impact: SEO-ready production site where non-developers publish structured pages without frontend redeploys.

matchtutors.title: Match Tutors
matchtutors.outcome: Realtime marketplace — queued AI matching deployed on AWS.
matchtutors.summary: A tutor–student marketplace that brings profiles, scheduling, AI-assisted matching, realtime chat, and payments into one workflow.

bullets.highlight1: Built a React + TypeScript marketplace with scheduling, chat, and PayOS checkout in production.
bullets.highlight2: Implemented realtime Socket.io messaging and BullMQ workers on Redis for async AI matching.
bullets.highlight3: Deployed capstone to AWS with Docker, JWT/OAuth auth, and split frontend/backend repos.

highlights.shipped: Tutor/student profiles, scheduling, session management, PayOS checkout, JWT + Google OAuth, S3 file uploads, and Socket.io messaging with live booking updates.
highlights.decisions: MongoDB collections with indexed query paths; OpenAI embeddings + BullMQ workers on Redis for async matching; Express middleware auth; Dockerized AWS deploy with env-specific secrets.
highlights.impact: Capstone shipped to AWS with realtime chat/booking, queued AI matching, and a split React + Express codebase ready for iteration.
